concepts.title: Hindi Lessons with Comprehension
concepts.description: Hindi Lessons with Comprehension — part of the chapter on गद्य — Prose.
key_ideas: Core principles of hindi lessons with comprehension
Step-by-step problem solving for hindi lessons with comprehension
Real-world applications of hindi lessons with comprehension

concepts.title: Vocabulary and Idioms in Context
concepts.description: Understanding difficult words (Shabdarth), synonyms, antonyms, and idioms (Muhavare) as used within the prose chapters.
key_ideas: Inferring meaning from context clues
Usage of Muhavare (idioms) and Lokoktiyan (proverbs)
Tatsam and Tadbhav words found in lessons

concepts.title: Identification of Prose Genres (Vidha)
concepts.description: Distinguishing between different forms of prose writing such as stories (Kahani), essays (Nibandh), memoirs (Sansmaran), and travelogues (Yatra Vrittant).
key_ideas: Characteristics of a Story vs. an Essay
Understanding Autobiographical elements
Recognizing Descriptive vs. Narrative writing styles

concepts.title: Character Sketch (Charitra Chitran)
concepts.description: Analyzing the personality traits, motivations, and development of major and minor characters within the stories.
key_ideas: Identifying physical and behavioral traits
Understanding character motivations and conflicts
Writing a structured character sketch

concepts.title: Structured Answer Writing
concepts.description: Techniques for formulating concise and comprehensive answers to textual questions, including reference to context (Sandarbh Sahit Vyakhya).
key_ideas: Structuring short vs. long answer questions
Writing 'Reference to Context' (Vyakhya)
Using textual evidence to support answers

concepts.title: Themes and Moral Values
concepts.description: Evaluating the central theme, social message, or moral lesson conveyed by the author in the prose chapters.
key_ideas: Identifying the central idea (Mool Bhaav)
Connecting stories to real-world social issues
Critiquing the author's message or conclusion

concepts.title: Hindi Poems and Bhavarth
concepts.description: Hindi Poems and Bhavarth — part of the chapter on पद्य — Poetry.
key_ideas: Core principles of hindi poems and bhavarth
Step-by-step problem solving for hindi poems and bhavarth
Real-world applications of hindi poems and bhavarth

concepts.title: Poetic Vocabulary and Dialects
concepts.description: Understanding the specific vocabulary, word origins (Tatsam/Tadbhav), and regional dialects (like Braj or Avadhi) used in Hindi poetry to enhance comprehension.
key_ideas: Identifying difficult words (Kathin Shabd)
Understanding dialect-specific terms (e.g., Braj Bhasha words in Surdas)
Synonyms and antonyms in poetic context

concepts.title: Recitation and Intonation (Sashwar Vachan)
concepts.description: Learning the art of reciting poems with correct rhythm, pause, pronunciation, and emotional expression appropriate to the poem's mood (Ras).
key_ideas: Correct pronunciation (Ucharan)
Rhythm and flow (Laya and Gati)
Expressing emotion through voice modulation

concepts.title: Reference to Context (Sandarbh Sahit Vyakhya)
concepts.description: Structuring the explanation of poem verses by identifying the poet, the source text, the context (Prasang), and expanding on the meaning (Vyakhya).
key_ideas: Writing the Reference (Sandarbh - Poet and Book)
Setting the Context (Prasang)
Detailed elaboration of the verse (Vyakhya)

concepts.title: Introduction to Poetic Devices
concepts.description: Identifying basic literary devices and structural elements that add beauty to the poem, such as rhyming words and simple figures of speech suitable for Class 7.
key_ideas: Rhyming words (Tukant Shabd)
Introduction to basic Alankar (e.g., Anupras/Alliteration)
Visual imagery in poetry

concepts.title: Thematic Analysis and Moral Values
concepts.description: Extracting the central theme (Kendriya Bhav) and evaluating the moral or social message conveyed by the poet.
key_ideas: Identifying the Central Idea (Kendriya Bhav)
Connecting the poem to real-life values (Mulya)
Critical appreciation of the poet's intent

concepts.title: क्रिया और काल
concepts.description: क्रिया और काल — part of the chapter on व्याकरण.
key_ideas: Core principles of क्रिया और काल
Step-by-step problem solving for क्रिया और काल
Real-world applications of क्रिया और काल

concepts.title: समास परिचय
concepts.description: समास परिचय — part of the chapter on व्याकरण.
key_ideas: Core principles of समास परिचय
Step-by-step problem solving for समास परिचय
Real-world applications of समास परिचय

concepts.title: विशेषण के भेद
concepts.description: संज्ञा या सर्वनाम की विशेषता बताने वाले शब्दों (विशेषण) और उनके चार मुख्य भेदों का अध्ययन।
key_ideas: विशेषण और विशेष्य की परिभाषा
गुणवाचक और संख्यावाचक विशेषण
परिमाणवाचक और सार्वनामिक विशेषण

concepts.title: उपसर्ग और प्रत्यय
concepts.description: मूल शब्दों के आरंभ या अंत में शब्दांश जोड़कर नए शब्दों का निर्माण करने की प्रक्रिया।
key_ideas: उपसर्ग: शब्द के आरंभ में जुड़ने वाले शब्दांश
प्रत्यय: शब्द के अंत में जुड़ने वाले शब्दांश
नए शब्दों का निर्माण और अर्थ परिवर्तन

concepts.title: संधि और संधि-विच्छेद
concepts.description: दो वर्णों के मेल से होने वाले विकार (परिवर्तन) को संधि कहते हैं। इस अवधारणा में स्वर संधि पर विशेष ध्यान दिया जाएगा।
key_ideas: संधि (वर्णों का मेल) बनाम समास (शब्दों का मेल)
स्वर संधि के प्रमुख नियम
संधि-विच्छेद (शब्दों को अलग करना)

concepts.title: कारक और विभक्तियाँ
concepts.description: संज्ञा या सर्वनाम का वाक्य के अन्य पदों (विशेषकर क्रिया) से संबंध जोड़ने वाले रूपों का ज्ञान।
key_ideas: कारक के आठ भेद
परसर्ग (विभक्ति चिह्न) की पहचान (ने, को, से, आदि)
कर्ता, कर्म और करण कारक में अंतर

concepts.title: मुहावरे और लोकोक्तियाँ
concepts.description: भाषा को प्रभावशाली बनाने के लिए विशेष अर्थ प्रकट करने वाले वाक्यांशों का प्रयोग।
key_ideas: सामान्य अर्थ बनाम लाक्षणिक (विशेष) अर्थ
वाक्य प्रयोग द्वारा अर्थ स्पष्ट करना
मुहावरों और लोकोक्तियों का अंतर

concepts.title: Essay and Letter Writing
concepts.description: Essay and Letter Writing — part of the chapter on लेखन.
key_ideas: Core principles of essay and letter writing
Step-by-step problem solving for essay and letter writing
Real-world applications of essay and letter writing

concepts.title: Anuched Lekhan (Paragraph Writing)
concepts.description: Developing the skill to express views on a specific topic concisely in a single paragraph, focusing on unity of thought and coherence.
key_ideas: Focusing on a single central idea without digressing
Maintaining a logical flow of sentences
Using concise language within a limited word count (80-100 words)
Writing a strong opening and concluding sentence

concepts.title: Samvad Lekhan (Dialogue Writing)
concepts.description: Learning to write conversations between two or more characters, ensuring natural flow and appropriate language based on the context and relationship.
key_ideas: Using appropriate punctuation marks for speech
Adapting tone (formal vs. informal) based on the characters
Keeping dialogues short, natural, and engaging
Advancing a situation or topic through conversation

concepts.title: Chitra Varnan (Picture Description)
concepts.description: Enhancing observation and expression skills by analyzing a visual image and describing the scene, actions, and mood in written Hindi.
key_ideas: Observing minute details in the background and foreground
Using present tense to describe ongoing actions in the picture
Connecting visual elements to form a coherent narrative
Expressing the mood or atmosphere of the image

concepts.title: Diary Lekhan (Diary Entry)
concepts.description: Practicing personal writing by recording daily events, thoughts, and feelings in a diary format using the first-person perspective.
key_ideas: Correct formatting including date, day, and time
Using 'Main' (I) perspective for personal expression
Writing honestly about feelings and reactions to events
Using an informal and emotive style of language

concepts.title: Suchna Lekhan (Notice Writing)
concepts.description: Understanding the format and purpose of formal notices to convey information to a specific group clearly and briefly.
key_ideas: Adhering to the standard box format
Including essential details: Heading, Date, Target Audience, and Issuer
Using formal, objective, and precise language
Conveying the message completely within a strict word limit
